account_security_events_staff.name: account_security_events_staff
account_security_events_staff.value: ("account_security_events"."actor_type" = 'staff' and "account_security_events"."actor_staff_id" is not null and "account_security_events"."reason_type" is not null) or ("account_security_events"."actor_type" <> 'staff' and "account_security_events"."actor_staff_id" is null and "account_security_events"."reason_type" is null)

account_security_events_details.name: account_security_events_details
account_security_events_details.value: jsonb_typeof("account_security_events"."details") = 'object' and ("account_security_events"."details" - 'sessionId' - 'recoveryId') = '{}'::jsonb and (not ("account_security_events"."details" ? 'sessionId') or coalesce(("account_security_events"."details"->>'sessionId') ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$', false)) and (not ("account_security_events"."details" ? 'recoveryId') or coalesce(("account_security_events"."details"->>'recoveryId') ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$', false))

users_has_identifier.name: users_has_identifier
users_has_identifier.value: "users"."phone" is not null or "users"."email" is not null

automations_balance_pause_revision.name: automations_balance_pause_revision
automations_balance_pause_revision.value:
"automations"."pause_reason" is distinct from 'balance'
        or ("automations"."balance_pause_revision" is not null and "automations"."balance_pause_revision" >= 0)

coupons_duration_months.name: coupons_duration_months
coupons_duration_months.value: ("coupons"."duration" = 'months' and "coupons"."duration_months" is not null and "coupons"."duration_months" between 1 and 36) or ("coupons"."duration" in ('once', 'forever') and "coupons"."duration_months" is null)

coupons_value.name: coupons_value
coupons_value.value: ("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."discount_percent" between 1 and 100 and "coupons"."discount_amount_poisha" is null) or ("coupons"."kind" = 'amount' and "coupons"."discount_amount_poisha" > 0 and "coupons"."discount_percent" is null)

campaigns_counts_pending_idx.name: campaigns_counts_pending_idx
campaigns_counts_pending_idx.where: "campaigns"."counts_at" is null and "campaigns"."approved_at" is not null and "campaigns"."status" in ('paused', 'sent', 'cancelled', 'failed')

campaigns_connection.name: campaigns_connection
campaigns_connection.value: case when "campaigns"."channel" = 'sms' then "campaigns"."channel_connection_id" is null else "campaigns"."status" = 'draft' or "campaigns"."channel_connection_id" is not null end

contacts_birthday_idx.name: contacts_birthday_idx
contacts_birthday_idx.where: "contacts"."deleted_at" is null and "contacts"."birthday_month" is not null

contacts_store_id_phone_key.name: contacts_store_id_phone_key
contacts_store_id_phone_key.where: "contacts"."phone" is not null and "contacts"."deleted_at" is null

contacts_verified_needs_phone.name: contacts_verified_needs_phone
contacts_verified_needs_phone.value: "contacts"."phone_verified_at" is null or "contacts"."phone" is not null

due_entries_note.name: due_entries_note
due_entries_note.value: char_length("due_entries"."note") <= 500 and ("due_entries"."kind" <> 'write_off' or "due_entries"."note" is not null)

discount_codes_value.name: discount_codes_value
discount_codes_value.value: ("discount_codes"."kind" = 'percent' and "discount_codes"."discount_percent" between 1 and 100 and "discount_codes"."discount_amount_poisha" is null) or ("discount_codes"."kind" = 'amount' and "discount_codes"."discount_amount_poisha" > 0 and "discount_codes"."discount_percent" is null) or ("discount_codes"."kind" = 'free_delivery' and "discount_codes"."discount_percent" is null and "discount_codes"."discount_amount_poisha" is null)

orders_recipient_required.name: orders_recipient_required
orders_recipient_required.value: "orders"."source" = 'khata_import' or ("orders"."recipient_phone" is not null and "orders"."recipient_address" is not null and "orders"."recipient_district" is not null)

payment_intents_flow_credentials.name: payment_intents_flow_credentials
payment_intents_flow_credentials.value:
("payment_intents"."flow" = 'billing' and "payment_intents"."credential_id" is null and "payment_intents"."gateway" <> 'manual' and "payment_intents"."order_id" is null)
       or ("payment_intents"."flow" = 'shop' and ("payment_intents"."gateway" = 'manual') = ("payment_intents"."credential_id" is null) and "payment_intents"."invoice_id" is null)

product_variants_external_identity.name: product_variants_external_identity
product_variants_external_identity.value:
("product_variants"."external_ref" is null and "product_variants"."external_source" is null and "product_variants"."external_account_id" is null)
        or ("product_variants"."external_ref" is not null and "product_variants"."external_source" is not null and "product_variants"."external_account_id" is not null)

post_targets_scheduled_has_time.name: post_targets_scheduled_has_time
post_targets_scheduled_has_time.value: "post_targets"."status" not in ('scheduled', 'publishing') or "post_targets"."scheduled_for" is not null

memberships_invite_has_address.name: memberships_invite_has_address
memberships_invite_has_address.value: "memberships"."status" <> 'invited' or "memberships"."invite_phone" is not null or "memberships"."invite_email" is not null
